name: @ng-email/components
description: Standalone Angular components for HTML email, with the Outlook, Gmail, Yahoo and Apple Mail workarounds built in.

scripts.build: ng-packagr -p ng-package.json -c tsconfig.lib.json && cp ../../LICENSE README.md dist/
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "console.error('Publish the built package instead: npm publish packages/components/dist'); process.exit(1)"
